head: Play That Back camera app: film with live looks on iPhone and Duo
dek: Play That Back is a new free camera app for iPhone and iPad that shows a colour look live while you film and keeps a clean original of every shot. On the iPhone Duo, the person you're filming sees the look on the outer screen and can pick it.
details: The free version has manual controls for ISO, shutter, white balance and focus, four of its 17 looks and two looks it learns from 6 to 12 photos you edited. Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, with all the looks, curves and colour wheels and more fixes. It can import .cube LUT files, and a check shows what an app's compression and crop will do to a clip before you post it. It's made by Storytailor Inc., needs iOS 26, and a separate Mac app syncs your looks through iCloud Drive.
where: iPhone and iPad, iOS 26 or later; free with a one-time Plus purchase
means: If you film videos for social apps on your phone, this gives you a finished look while you shoot instead of editing it in later.
todo: Try the free version first; Plus is one payment if you want all 17 looks.
thumb_words: PLAY THAT BACK: LIVE FILM LOOKS
